The original TypeScript source includes its MIT notice. `qrcodegen.js` is compiled with TypeScript 5.8.3 to ES2020, with a default module export added. Qrer retains the function-module mask instead of clearing it after encoding, so photo rendering can preserve every finder, alignment, timing, format and version module. Encoding is unchanged.
